name: essential-dialog-gsap
title: Essential Dialog (GSAP)
author: Anthony Cifuentes
description: The same morphing <dialog>, driven by GSAP Flip instead of Motion — it animates a real width and height rather than projecting a transform. Exports exactly the same names as `essential-dialog`, so the two are interchangeable by import path. Reach for it if you would rather not add Motion to the bundle.
docs: Identical API to `essential-dialog` apart from two Motion-only props: `bounce` (the opening spring's overshoot) and `dismissOnOutsideClick` (always on here). Flip and CustomEase have been free since GSAP 3.13.
